qe: In the book 'Bihar Through the Ages', Pataliputra is called the 'eternal city' of India because three great imperial powers ruled from it. Which were they?
qh: 'बिहार थ्रू द एजेज' पुस्तक में पाटलिपुत्र को भारत का 'शाश्वत नगर' कहा गया है क्योंकि तीन बड़ी साम्राज्य-शक्तियों ने यहीं से शासन किया। वे कौन थीं?
e: Pataliputra yaani aaj ka Patna prachin Bharat ke sabse mahatvapurn rajnitik kendra raha. 'Bihar Through the Ages' ke anusar Magadha ka ek chhota rajya 6th century BC me Bimbisara ke samay se badhta gaya tatha Mahapadma Nanda ne uttar Bharat ko ek kiya; uske baad Maurya samrajya ne yahan se poore desh par raj kiya. Mauryon ke patan ke lagbhag paanch sau saal baad Gupta shasakon ne Pataliputra ko hi apni rajdhani banakar uttar Bharat ki ekta dobara sthapit ki, tatha uske paanch sau saal baad Pala shasakon ne bhi isi nagar se raj karne ki parampara nibhai - isliye pustak ise 'shaashvat nagar' (eternal city) kehti hai. Yah parampara aaj tak chalti hai kyunki Bihar ki aaj ki rajdhani bhi Patna hi hai tatha Ganga ke kinare basa yah shahar maurya-kaaleen Kumrahar tatha Bulandibagh jaise puratatv-sthalon se ghira hua hai. Exam point: Pataliputra Maurya, Gupta tatha Pala - teeno ki rajdhani-kendra; aaj ka Patna kisi bhi ek samrajya ka nahi balki teen badi shaktiyon ka rajnetik kendra raha; Ganga ke kinare basa yah nagar aaj Bihar ki rajdhani hai.

qe: Which ruler of Magadha is described in 'Bihar Through the Ages' as the 6th century BC king under whom Magadha was still one of the many small states?
qh: 'बिहार थ्रू द एजेज' में छठी शताब्दी ईसा-पूर्व के किस मगध शासक के समय मगध अनेक छोटे राज्यों में से एक था?
e: Pustak ke anusar 6th century BC me Magadha dakshin Bihar ka ek chhota rajya tha jiske shasak Bimbisara the tatha aas-paas Anga, Vajji, Malla jaise kai anya chhote rajya bhi maujood the. Bimbisara ke uttaradhikariyon ne dhire-dhire seemayein badhai tatha agle sau-bhar saal me Magadha angrajyon me sarvashreshth ban gaya; isi parampara ko Mahapadma Nanda ne aage badhaya, jinhone uttar Bharat ke bade hisse ko ek shasak ke adheen kar diya. Iske baad Chandragupta Maurya ne sikandar ke baad ki rajnitik khaali jagah bhar kar poora uttar tatha madhya Bharat jodkar bharat ka pehla sarva-bharatiya samrajya khada kiya; Samudragupta Gupta kaal me isi vistarit samrajya ki neev par raj kiya. Isi liye 'chhote rajya se samrajya tak' ki yatra Magadha ke Haryanka kaal ke Bimbisara se maani jaati hai, isliye sahi uttar Bimbisara hai. Exam point: 6th century BC me Magadha ek chhota rajya tha jiska raja Bimbisara tha; uske baad Mahapadma Nanda ne uttar Bharat ka bada hissa joda tatha Mauryon ne pehla sarva-bharatiya samrajya khada kiya.

qe: 'Bihar Through the Ages' notes that the long-lost text of Kautilya's Arthashastra, a work associated with the Maurya court, was recovered from where?
qh: 'बिहार थ्रू द एजेज' के अनुसार मौर्य दरबार से जुड़ा कौटिल्य का अर्थशास्त्र, जो कालांतर में खो गया था, कहाँ से पुनः प्राप्त हुआ?
oe: From a southern corner of India
e: Kautilya, jinko Chanakya bhi kaha jaata hai, Chandragupta Maurya ke pradhanmantri the tatha unke netritva me Nanda rajavansh hata kar Maurya vansh sthapit hua; unki rachna 'Arthashastra' rajniti, prashasan, kar-vyavastha, kanoon tatha arthavyavastha ka vishal granth hai. Pustak ke anusar is granth ki rachna Bihar ke rajnitik mahaul me hui - Kautilya ke baare me parampara kehti hai ki unhone apna jeevan Magadha ke darbaron me bitaya; isliye yah karya Bihar se juda maana jaata hai. Yeh granth itna prabhavshali tha ki aage ke sabhi raja tatha rajnitigya ise aadarsh guide maante the. Dilchasp baat yah hai ki yah granth Bharat me kai sadiyon tak lapata raha aur iski ek purani pandulipi bharat ke sabse dakshin korner (Mysore kshetra) ki library se mili, jisse yah dobara duniya ke saamne aaya. Isliye sahi uttar 'Bharat ke dakshini kone se' hai. Exam point: Arthashastra ki rachna Kautilya/Chanakya ne Magadha ke rajnitik mahaul me ki; purani pandulipi Bharat ke dakshini kone (Mysore) se mili; Granth prashasan, kar tatha kanoon ka aadhaar-granth maana jaata hai.

qe: According to 'Bihar Through the Ages', which ideal did ancient Magadha and Pataliputra give to the rest of India?
qh: 'बिहार थ्रू द एजेज' के अनुसार प्राचीन मगध तथा पाटलिपुत्र ने शेष भारत को कौन-सा आदर्श दिया?
oe: The ideal of political unity of India
The ideal of a single world religion
The ideal of a money-less economy
oh: भारत की राजनीतिक एकता का आदर्श
e: Pustak ka mukhya nishkarsh yah hai ki prachin kaal me Bihar ne 'bharat ki rajnitik ekta' ke aadarsh ko janm diya tatha use vyavhar me utara. Magadha ke chhote rajya se shuru hokar Mahapadma Nanda, Maurya, Gupta tatha Pala shasakon ke prayas se ek vishal kshetra ek hi shasan-vyavastha, ek hi bhasha tatha ek hi shasan-lekh ke adheen aaya; Maurya samrajya ke samay Pataliputra se likhit aadesh Himalaya se Hindu Kush, Kathiawar, Arabian Sagar, Mysore ke pathar tatha Bangal ki khadi-Brahmaputra tak pahunchte the. Isi ekta ne bhasha, lipi, dharm tatha kala ke aadan-pradan ko aasan banaya tatha Mauryon ke patan ke baad bhi bharat ki sanskritik ekta bani rahi - yahi is pustak ka pramukh vichar hai. Rajnitik ekta ke saath-saath sahishnuta tatha sanskritik aadan-pradan bhi isi aadarsh ka hissa raha; isliye sahi uttar 'bharat ki rajnitik ekta ka aadarsh' hai. Exam point: Magadha-Pataliputra ka sarvadhik mahatvapurn yogdaan = bharat ki rajnitik ekta ka aadarsh tatha uske liye pehli baar vistarit prashasan-vyavastha ka nirman; Maurya samrajya poore uttar-madhya bharat ko ek shasan me laaya.

qe: Which ancient kingdom, associated with Raja Janaka and the philosopher Yajnavalkya, formed the northern part of today's Bihar region?
qh: राजा जनक तथा दार्शनिक याज्ञवल्क्य से जुड़ा प्राचीन राज्य, जो आज के बिहार क्षेत्र का उत्तरी हिस्सा था, कौन-सा है?
e: Videha rajya aaj ke uttar Bihar ke Mithila kshetra me tha; uski pehchan Raja Janaka tatha unke darbar ke vidwan Yajnavalkya se hai; Brihadaranyaka Upanishad me Janaka tatha Yajnavalkya ke beech hue gambhir darshanik samvad milte hain. Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne 'Bihar Through the Ages' ke apne sandesh me likha hai ki Bihar Janaka tatha Yagnavalkya ki bhoomi hai tatha sath hi Gautama, Mahavira, Buddha, Chandragupta, Chanakya tatha Ashoka ki bhi. Anga rajya aaj ke Bhagalpur-Munger kshetra me tha tatha uski rajdhani Champa thi; Kashi (Varanasi) tatha Kosala (Ayodhya) aaj ke Uttar Pradesh me the, isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi hain. Isi liye Janaka-Yajnavalkya se jude rajy ka sahi naam Videha (Mithila) hai. Exam point: Videha = Mithila kshetra, Raja Janaka tatha Yajnavalkya se juda prachin rajya; Anga ki rajdhani Champa (Bhagalpur-Munger kshetra); Kosala tatha Kashi aaj UP me hain.

qe: The lion capital and the famous bull capital of Ashokan pillars were both discovered at which place in West Champaran, Bihar?
qh: अशोक-स्तंभ के सिंह-शीर्ष तथा प्रसिद्ध वृषभ (बैल) शीर्ष दोनों बिहार के पश्चिम चंपारण में कहाँ मिले थे?
e: Rampurva Pashchim Champaran me sthit ek sthal hai jahan Ashoka ke do stambh-shirsh milte hain - ek sinha-shirsh (lion capital) tatha ek vrishabh-shirsh (bull capital); yah dono aaj Patna Museum tatha National Museum me surakshit hain. Ashoka ne apne dhamma ka prachar karne ke liye poore samrajya me patthar ke stambh lagwaye tatha un par prakrut bhasha me sandesh khudwaye; Bihar me aise stambh Rampurva, Lauriya Nandangarh, Lauriya Araraj tatha Kolhua (Vaishali) me mile hain. Rampurva ka vrishabh-shirsh isliye khaas hai kyunki aise pashu-shirsh Maurya kaal ki dhatu-kala tatha patthar par polish ke sabse sudar udaharan maane jaate hain. Lauriya Nandangarh ka stambh abhi bhi apni jagah khada hai tatha wahan ek bada tila (Nandangarh) bhi hai; Kolhua me sinha-stambh hai. Isliye dono capitals ke liye sahi uttar Rampurva hai. Exam point: Rampurva (Pashchim Champaran) = Ashoka ke sinha-shirsh tatha vrishabh-shirsh dono stambh-shirsh mile; Bihar me Ashokan stambh Rampurva, Lauriya Nandangarh, Lauriya Araraj tatha Kolhua (Vaishali) me hain.

qe: The polished Yakshi figure found at Didarganj near Patna, a masterpiece of Mauryan art, is displayed in which museum?
qh: पटना के निकट दीदारगंज से मिली पॉलिशयुक्त यक्षी मूर्ति, जो मौर्य कला की उत्कृष्ट कृति है, किस संग्रहालय में प्रदर्शित है?
e: Didarganj (Patna) me Ganga ke kinare se ek sundar pathar ki yakshi murti mili thi; yah Maurya kaal ki kala ka sabse prasiddh namuna maani jaati hai kyunki iske patthar par chikni polish hai tatha aakriti bahut jeevant hai - ise 'Didarganj Yakshi' kaha jaata hai tatha yah aaj Patna Museum me rakhi hai. Maurya kaal ki kala ki khaas pehchan chunni (polish) wala patthar tatha chamakdar surface hai; isi tarah Kumrahar (Patna) ke prachin 'sabhaghar' ke khambhe tatha Barabar ki pahadiyon ki gufaon me bhi yahi polish dikhti hai. Aisi murtiyan batati hain ki us samay nagar-sabhyata me shilp tatha kaarigari kitni unnati prapt thi tatha vastra tatha aabhushan ki bareeki kaisi thi. National Museum, Indian Museum tatha Sarnath Museum me bhi Maurya-Gupta kaal ki manya vastuein hain, lekin Didaarganj Yakshi Patna Museum ki shaan hai. Exam point: Didaarganj Yakshi = Maurya kaal ki polish-wali patthar murti, Patna Museum me; Maurya kala ki pehchan chikni chunni/patthar-polish hai, jaisi Kumrahar ke sabhaghar ke khambhon me bhi dikhti hai.

qe: Remains of a pillared assembly hall of the Mauryan period were excavated at which locality of Patna?
qh: मौर्यकालीन स्तंभ-युक्त सभागार के अवशेष पटना के किस स्थल पर मिले हैं?
e: Patna ke Kumrahar kshetra me khudai me Maurya kaal ke ek bade sabha-grih (pillared hall) ke khambhon ke adhaar mile; unhe dekh kar andaza hota hai ki us samay Pataliputra me lakdi ke khambhon par khadi vishal imartein banti thi. Isi ke paas Bulandibagh me bhi Mauryan kaal ke avashesh mile; wahan se pathar par bani Maurya-kaaleen vastuein tatha terracotta ki chhoti murtiyan mili hain, jo Patna Museum me rakhi hain. In avasheshon ka mahatva isliye bhi hai ki yah prachin sahitya me varnit Pataliputra ke vaibhav ki pushti karte hain, jahan darbar, khazana tatha sainik chhavniyan thi tatha Ganga kinare bade bandargah the. Didarganj se yakshi murti mili, Maner se Sufi dargah (Shah Daulat) tatha Punpun se nadi ka naam juda hai - isliye sabha-grih ke avashesh ke liye sahi uttar Kumrahar hai. Exam point: Kumrahar (Patna) tatha uske paas Bulandibagh = Maurya kaal ke sabha-grih tatha nagar-basav ke avashesh; yahi kshetra prachin Pataliputra ka mukhya hissa maana jaata hai.

qe: According to 'Bihar Through the Ages', which two rivers marked the eastern limit of the Maurya empire?
qh: 'बिहार थ्रू द एजेज' के अनुसार मौर्य साम्राज्य की पूर्वी सीमा किन दो नदियों/जल-निकायों तक थी?
oe: The Arabian Sea and the Indus
The Bay of Bengal and the Brahmaputra
e: Pustak ke anusar Maurya samrajya itna vishal tha ki Pataliputra se jaari aadesh (likhit writ) rajy ke ek kone se doosre kone tak pahunchte the; iski seemayein uttar me Himalaya, uttar-pashchim me Hindu Kush, pashchim me Kathiawar tatha Arabian Sagar, dakshin me Mysore ka pathar tatha purab me Bangal ki khadi tatha Brahmaputra nadi tak phaili hui thi. Itne bade kshetra me ek hi bhasha tatha ek hi lipi ke aadesh chalte the, jisse rashtriya ekta ko bal mila; yahi vajah hai ki Maurya samrajya ko bharat ka pehla sarva-bharatiya samrajya kaha jaata hai. Iske aage Gupta tatha Pala shasakon ne bhi ekta sthapit karne ke prayas kiye, isliye Pataliputra ki rajnitik parampara bahut lambi rahi. Indus tatha Arabian Sagar pashchim me tatha Godavari-Krishna dakshin me hain, isliye purabi seema ke liye sahi uttar Bangal ki khadi tatha Brahmaputra hai. Exam point: Maurya samrajya ki purabi seema = Bangal ki khadi tatha Brahmaputra; uttar me Himalaya tatha uttar-pashchim me Hindu Kush tak vistaar; ek hi bhasha-lipi ke shasan-aadesh poore samrajya me chalte the.
